questions.question: Kargil Vijay Diwas is observed annually on July 26 to commemorate the success of which Indian Army operation?
questions.explanation: Kargil Vijay Diwas is celebrated on July 26 each year to commemorate the Indian Army's victory in 'Operation Vijay' against Pakistan in the Kargil War of 1999. This year marks the 27th anniversary of the successful culmination of the nearly three-month-long battle on the icy heights of Kargil in Ladakh.
questions.background: The Kargil War took place between May and July 1999 in the Kargil district of Jammu and Kashmir (now Ladakh). The day honours the sacrifices of the soldiers who laid down their lives for the nation during the conflict.
questions.examRelevance: Kargil Vijay Diwas = July 26, commemorates Operation Vijay (1999).

source.title: Kargil Vijay Diwas: President Murmu, PM Modi lead nation to pay tributes to war heroes on 27th anniversary of ‘Operation Vijay’
